description: Makes a new ad for the user's brand modeled on one Sightglass image ad: the same layout and style, with new copy and the brand's logo, colors and products, and nothing of the original brand's. With storeUrl and no projectId it uses the user's project for that website, or creates one, and reads the brand from the site when the project has none. Ads with only a video have no still to start from. Replo renders the ad in about a minute for about 9 of the workspace's credits; a workspace with no credits is refused before anything is made. A finished ad can be saved to Meta Ads or Google Ads as a paused draft with sightglass_send_ad. Editing or resizing it in Canvas: the building-canvases skill. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

adId.description: The ad's own id, from sightglass_find_ads.

direction.description: What to change from the reference, in the user's words (for example 'warmer, lead with the cardigan'). Leave it out to let the reference and the brand steer.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

storeUrl.description: The user's store website as a full address with https://, e.g. https://candles.example, even when the user typed candles.example. Without a projectId it picks the project saved for that website, or makes one, and reads the brand (logo, colors, products) from the site when the project has none yet. Leave it out when you pass a projectId; with neither, the ad goes into the user's only project, or the call asks which one.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_duplicate_ad
title: Duplicate an ad for my brand
